metadata.notes: The exact original six-jar, four-route, nine-notch configuration is assigned L2. Browser and independent replay share explicit path, route-progress, spur, vortex, recovery, and effect-disc geometry while binding the selected interaction surface. The visible surface exposes selection state and final PASS or FAIL without textual partial correctness.
